issues.description: Resource IDs are interpolated into URL paths without percent-encoding, so slash or dot-segment IDs can change the requested endpoint.
Retry policy retries non-idempotent POST operations on 429/5xx without idempotency keys, risking duplicate task creation or duplicate review side effects.
Task.to_dict() raises TypeError at runtime because zero-argument super() is broken in this slotted dataclass inheritance case.
Transport and timeout exceptions from httpx are not caught, retried, or wrapped in LumenAPIError, so callers see inconsistent exception types.
Pagination has no progress guard, so a repeated next_cursor from the API can create an infinite loop.
List endpoints silently ignore missing or malformed items instead of raising, which can hide API contract regressions and data loss.
Response parsers accept invalid Literal values and raise raw KeyError/ValueError/TypeError for malformed API data instead of typed validation errors.
Retry-After only supports numeric seconds and ignores valid HTTP-date header values.
max_attempts is not validated, so zero or negative values produce a misleading 'request was not attempted' error.
